passiveEffects.name: Snow Cloak
passiveEffects.originalDescription: After Ice Shard or Ice Beam is used, the user gains 10% damage resistance for 4s; after Icy Wind, Blizzard, or Unite Move is used the user gains 20% damage resistance for 5s. If move 1 or Unite Move is used after move 2 activated the ability, then the effect is dynamically upgraded to the improved version. Afterwards the ability goes on cooldown for 10s. Icy Wind, Blizzard, and Ice Wing Whiteout apply a freeze counter on opposing Pokémon when they hit. This freeze counter goes up to 5 stacks, lasts for 3s and refreshes when another stack is applied, and applies a stacking 12% slow based on the amount of stacks of the freeze counter. Once the freeze counter reaches 5 stacks, that Pokémon gets frozen for 1.1s.

moveEffects.name: Ice Shard
moveEffects.originalDescription: The user hurls a chunk of ice in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit and slowing them by 40% for 2.5s. If the target has at least 1 stack of the freeze counter, they will become frozen consuming the counter. If the target is already frozen the move instead deals increased damage.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Ice Wing Whiteout
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: The user becomes Unstoppable and immobile, summoning a raging blizzard centered on themself, dealing damage in 5 waves. The second wave deals 5% more damage, third 10%, fourth 15%, and the fifth deals 100% more damage. If the move hits an ally goal zone, a chunk of ice forms on the zone, blocking movement and scoring. The goal zone still provides healing and shielding by standing at the edge of it. This chunk of ice will remain until it is destroyed. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield
